title: KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans — Expiration, Forfeiture of Unused Visits and Non-Transferability
content:
### Article 1 — Expiration

A KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan expires at the earlier of its expiration date (plus any grace for a visit booked before expiry) and its expiration odometer. Whichever of the two limits the plan reaches first ends it; the plan's status then becomes expired.

### Article 2 — Forfeiture

When a plan expires, its unused visits are forfeited and nothing is refunded for them. The forfeiture removes the visits remaining on the plan at that date. Visits are forfeited only on a plan whose status is expired or cancelled.

### Article 3 — No transfer

Plans are not transferable to a new owner. A holder who sells the vehicle may cancel the plan instead.

## Article 1 in figures (hypothetical plans)

The dates, readings and visit counts below are example inputs only.

| Example plan | Expiration date | Expiration odometer | What happens first | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Maintenance Standard | 2028-04-15 | 62310 | The vehicle passes 62310 miles in 2027, before the date | Expires by mileage; any unused visits are forfeited, with no refund |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Starter | 2027-06-01 | 55100 | The date arrives with the odometer below 55100 | Expires by date; any unused visits are forfeited, with no refund |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max | 2029-09-30 | 70000 | The date arrives with the odometer below 70000 and a visit booked before expiry | Expires at the expiration date plus the plan's grace for that booked visit, unless the expiration odometer is reached earlier |

## Points of judgement

**Is anything refunded for visits left at expiry?** No. Unused visits are forfeited and nothing is refunded.

**On which plans are visits forfeited?** Only on a plan whose status is expired or cancelled. A plan whose status is active or fulfilled has no forfeiture recorded against it.

**Can the plan move with the vehicle to a buyer?** No. Plans are not transferable; the holder who sells the vehicle may cancel the plan instead.

**Hypothetical forfeiture.** A KestrelCare Maintenance Basic plan (an example) expires by date with 2 of its 3 visits unused. The 2 remaining visits are forfeited, and no amount is refunded for them.
